description: Sets an alert on OwlChart data, checked every minute. Types: price_above = price goes above the threshold (dollars); price_below = price goes below the threshold (dollars); oi_change = open interest summed across 13 exchanges moves by the threshold percent from when the alert was set (negative number for a drop); magnet_hit = price reaches the liquidity magnet above or below that existed when the alert was set (no threshold needed); funding_extreme = average funding across exchanges reaches the threshold percent per funding period, either sign (for example 0.05); etf_flip = OwlChart spot ETF verdict for BTC or ETH changes (BUYING, SELLING, MIXED); coin must be BTC or ETH; stablecoin_mint = net stablecoins minted minus burned over 24 hours (all tracked issuers, read from the contracts) crosses the threshold in millions of dollars (negative number for net burn); coin is ignored; large_transfer = a single on-chain transfer of the token (coin = token hub id, e.g. USD1, USDC, BUIDL) of at least the threshold in millions of dollars is seen in the last hour (Ethereum contracts; see get_token_hub); reg_keyword = a new regulatory event whose title contains the keyword given in note appears on the Regulatory Radar (coin is ignored; threshold not needed); stable_print = v5.853: a big print of USDT or USDC (coin = USDT or USDC) lands on an exchange: $50M in one transfer or $100M inside an hour from the issuer treasury (no threshold needed); stable_pulse = v5.853: the Stablecoin Pulse label of USDT or USDC (coin) changes, BULLISH, NEUTRAL or BEARISH (no threshold needed); wlfi_buyback_surge = v5.888: the estimated WLFI buyback flow of the last 24 hours (World Liberty buying on Aster) reaches the threshold times its 7 day pace (for example 2 for double); coin must be WLFI; wlfi_buyback_stop = v5.888: the estimated WLFI buyback flow of the last 24 hours falls under $20,000, the buying has paused or ended (no threshold needed); coin must be WLFI; kimchi_premium = v5.887: the Upbit KRW price of CARV, in dollars, trades above the global price by the threshold percent or more (for example 5; a negative number fires when it is that far below); coin must be CARV; korea_volume = v5.887: the 24 hour CARV volume on Upbit plus Bithumb reaches the threshold times its own 7 day average (for example 2 for double); coin must be CARV; stable_depeg = v5.853: USDT or USDC (coin) trades more than 0.5% away from one dollar on a dollar venue for 5 minutes (no threshold needed). When it fires it shows in check_alerts and, if a webhook is given (Discord, Slack, Zapier, Make, n8n or any https hook), a message is sent there too. One-shot. Up to 10 active alerts per member.

threshold.description: Dollars for price alerts, percent for oi_change and funding_extreme
